title: Replication Package: DevOps for IoT Systems — Methodologies and Software Tools (Systematic Literature Review)
description: Protocol, search strings, screening data, included-study lists, data-extraction sheets, and machine-readable analysis tables (maturity assessment, tool catalog, tool→DevOps-phase mapping, comparison with prior reviews) supporting the systematic literature review 'DevOps for IoT Systems: Methodologies and Software Tools' by Ciancarini, Garlisi, Giancarlo and Grimaudo. Companion resources: GitHub process-tracking repository and a Zotero group library (see README).
